Subject: Discovery recap + next steps (evaluation roadmap attached)

Hi Samantha / Kyle,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and lots of useful context on AcmePay's fraud-risk workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we discussed
- Primary use-case: reduce false positives in chargeback triage for mid-ticket transactions (~$100–$1,200).
- Success metric: 15–20% reduction in manual review volume in month 1 of pilot.
- Data scope: anonymized transaction logs + webhook for flagged events.

Suggested evaluation roadmap (attached)
1) Kickoff & environment access (week 0) — confirm owners and data contact
2) Pilot ingest + baseline (weeks 1–2) — smoke tests & quality checks
3) Model tuning & latency validation (weeks 3–4)
4) Internal QA + ops runbook (week 5)

Action items for AcmePay
- Confirm owners for: data ingestion (who will provide S3 access), evaluation owner (product/ops), procurement point-of-contact for PO/contract.
- Share calendar windows for a 30–45m kickoff next week (I included a tentative slot in the link below).

Attached: Evaluation_Roadmap_v1.2.pdf (mutual action plan + milestone dates).

If anything above is off, call it out and I’ll update the doc. Can you confirm the three owners (data / evaluation / procurement) by EOD Thurs? If that timeline's tight, let me know the right date.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0189
